author: Sunaye
body:
Well, here I am  after one year. I have reached 100000 kills. Did nothing special, actually had no idea I had even gotten it. Until someone said congrats in game and I'm just like on what?  Then I realized oh xD.  So I would like to state an official Good Game! :D

Now who will be the next to 100000 kills?
